chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about bidding farewell to the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). He (peace be upon him) said: 'You should say: May Allah bless you. Peace be upon you. May Allah not make it the last of my greetings upon you.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended dua for bidding farewell to the Prophet's grave?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (as) prescribes a specific supplication for bidding farewell to the Prophet's grave, highlighting the Shia practice of maintaining an ongoing spiritual bond rather than a final departure. The phrase 'لا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ آخِرَ تَسْلِيمِي' (May God not make it my final greeting) reflects the theological hope for eternal connection and the belief that the Prophet's presence remains accessible to the faithful across time.
